answer: Vote weight here is the square of attested tenure: a vertex earns one epoch of tenure only by burning 1 kernel and passing a random liveness challenge that epoch. The orchard ties each vertex to its keys and funding wallets, and linked vertices share one tenure clock, crediting only one of them per epoch. A 100-epoch veteran weighs 10,000; 1,000 linked clones splitting those 100 epochs weigh 10 combined, since n clones get T²/n, so each extra clone shrinks the farm. It breaks if the orchard misses links hidden behind cheap fresh wallets.
